About the Colony

Basant
Kunj

A Meerut community (2018) built around open space, wide lanes, and long-term livability. Basant Kunj is a premium residential plotted development located in Meerut, UP. Designed with modern infrastructure and thoughtful planning, it offers a perfect blend of urban convenience and natural serenity.

Every aspect of the colony is crafted to ensure a premium lifestyle — from wide, well-laid roads to beautiful green landscapes. With 24/7 security, underground electricity, and dedicated water supply, this is where your dream home begins.
